Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning restoration of funding to in-home care services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restoring funding to in-home care services;adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW; creating a new section; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that in 2011 medicaidhome care hours were reduced for fortyfive thousand individuals by anaverage hour reduction of ten percent. This reduction has resulted inhardship for vulnerable seniors and people with disabilities which hasresulted in a decrease in the quality of life for patients across thestate. Recognizing the great hardship on Washington residents from thereduction in these services, it is the intent of the legislature torestore partial funding for these reduced hours.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Decisions as to the hours of inhome care to be provided must bebased solely upon an objective assessment of medical need, as follows:The department must provide eligible individuals with the hours of inhome care designated as the "base hours" for their inhome group, as p. 1 SB 6225set forth in WAC 3881060125, as it existed on December 1, 2010,unless the individual is eligible for a modification in hours pursuantto the objective standards set forth in WAC 3881060130 (2) through(6), as those subsections existed on December 1, 2010. The departmentmay consider no other factors.
